infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Bardwell Park
infoLinks.content:
Access to Bardwell Park Station is via temporary stairs on the eastern side of Hartill-Law Avenue to enable the demolition of the existing station stairs and construction of new stairs and a lift on the western side of Hartill-Law Avenue. Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. Buses replace some trains
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 29 and Sunday 30 August
  • Trains may run to a changed timetable due to trackwork between Strathfield and Central. Some trains may leave Central earlier than the normal train timetable.

  • Saturday from 8pm to 2.20am, trains run between Central Coast & Newcastle Line stations and Hornsby only.
  • T1 North Shore Line trains run between Hornsby and Wynyard, and T9 Northern Line trains run between Hornsby and Epping only.
  • Buses replace trains between Epping and Ashfield or Central.
  • Use metro services between Epping or Chatswood and the City.

  • The last trains to run between Central Coast & Newcastle Line stations and Central leave:
    - Wyong at 18:09, arriving Central at 20:17
    - Central at 19:43, arriving Wyong at 21:47

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
Saturday night
4T9  Epping, all stations to Strathfield, Ashfield and return 
3T9  Epping, Strathfield, Central and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus improvements in Kiama and Jamberoo from 20 July
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 July, we’re making changes to route S482 morning bus services in Kiama and Jamberoo to improve connectivity and travel times. 
  • Route S482 AM will now service only Jamberoo Public School.
  • Route S482 AM no longer operates to Kiama High School or Minnamurra Public School.
  • Kiama High School students from Jamberoo will instead use Route 125.
  • Students travelling to Minnamurra Public School from Curramore, Jamberoo or Jerrara who currently use the S482 morning service will need to change buses under the new arrangements. They will transfer from Route 125 to S493 at Ss Peter and Paul Catholic Parish Primary School at 8.37am. The bus schedules have been coordinated so students can move directly between services, with no waiting time required.
Plan your trip and read the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD, Martin Place diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the Sydney CBD are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.   
  • From 4am to 12pm, buses will start and end trips at Central instead of Martin Place. Buses to the city will end trips at Central on Pitt St before Hay St (2000434). Buses leaving the city will start trips from Pitt St opp Barlow St (200083).  
  • Catch trains or metro services to continue your trip between Central and Martin Place 
  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.
Missed stops:
  • Museum Station, Downing Centre, Stand E (200049)
  • Museum Station, Elizabeth St, Stand D (200055)
  • St James Station, Elizabeth St, Stand C (200057)
  • Martin Place Station, Elizabeth St, Stand C (2000421)
  • Martin Place Station, Elizabeth St, Stand G (2000232)
  • St James Station, Elizabeth St, Stand B (2000312)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace some trains
infoLinks.content:
Monday 31 August
  • From 8am to 1pm, buses replace trains between Newcastle Interchange and Telarah or Muswellbrook.
  • The 08:29 Newcastle Interchange to Dungog will not run. Catch the 08:48 Newcastle Interchange to Telarah train and change at Maitland for a bus towards Dungog.
  • Buses also replace the 10:02 Dungog to Newcastle Interchange service.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
1HU  Newcastle Interchange, all stations to Telarah and return
4HU  Maitland, all stations to Dungog (in that direction only)
7HU  Warabrook Station to University shuttle bus
15HU  Maitland, all stations to Muswellbrook (in that direction only)
19HU  Dungog, all stations to Maitland, Victoria Street, all stations to Beresfield, Warabrook, all stations to Newcastle Interchange (in that direction only)
28HU  Muswellbrook, all stations to Maitland, Victoria Street, all stations to Beresfield, Warabrook, all stations to Newcastle Interchange (in that direction only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.content:

As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.

infoLinks.urlText: T1 Western Line: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. Buses replace some trains
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 29 and Sunday 30 August
  • Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern.
  • Penrith trains make extra stops between Lidcombe and Ashfield.
  • Richmond trains run between Richmond and Liverpool. Change trains at Parramatta to continue your journey.

  • Saturday from 5.30am to 9am, buses replace trains between Richmond and Blacktown.\
  • From 9am to 11am, buses replace trains between Richmond and Schofields.
  • Trains run between Blacktown or Schofields and Liverpool.

  • Saturday from 8pm to 2am, buses replace trains between Olympic Park and Ashfield or Central. Trackwork buses do not leave from Lidcombe.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between:
    - Penrith and Olympic Park
    - Richmond and Liverpool
    - Ashfield and the City Circle
  • You may need to change services to continue your journey.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
Saturday morning
30T1  Richmond, all stations to Schofields and return
50T1  Richmond, all stations to Blacktown and return
57T1  Schofields, all stations to Blacktown and return

Saturday night
11T2  Olympic Park, all stations to Ashfield and return 
42T7  Olympic Park, Strathfield, Central and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and South East diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, Route 355 buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the city, Darlinghurst Moore Park and Kingsford are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
 
From 4am to 4pm, services will run between Marrickville and Surry Hills only, buses will not run between Bondi Junction and Darlinghurst.  
 
Buses from Marrickville will end trips on Cleveland St at Crown St (201047). Buses that usually start from Bondi Junction will start trips from Cleveland St at Marriott St (201636).  
 
Go to Central to connect with trains towards Bondi Junction, or catch route 333 buses from Kings Cross station. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and Pyrmont diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, Route 389 buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the Sydney CBD and Pyrmont are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  • Route 389 services will be split into two routes from 5am to 3.30pm between Pyrmont and Town Hall, and between the city/Woolloomooloo and Bondi Junction. 
  • Pyrmont-city services will not run until 11am due to road closures in Pyrmont.
  • From 11am to 3.30pm, buses will run as normal through Pyrmont but end trips at QVB, York St Stand B (200042).
  • Buses to Pyrmont will start trips from QVB, York St Stand B. For connections to Bondi Junction, catch trains from Town Hall. 
  • City-Bondi Jct: from 5am to 3.30pm, buses to Bondi Junction will start trips from Yurong St after William St (201070). Buses from Bondi Junction towards the city will end trips at Riley St at Kennedy St (201157). Continue on foot to QVB York St to connect with buses towards Pyrmont. 
  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details. 
Missed stops: 
  • Town Hall, Park St, Stand H (2000249)
  • Hyde Park, Park St, Stand B (2000157)
  • Australian Museum, William St (201084)
  • Hyde Park, Park St, Stand C (2000412)
  • Town Hall, Park St, Stand J (2000425)

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD & North Shore diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, Route N92 buses will be diverting and missing stops due to major road closures in North Sydney and on the Sydney Harbour Bridge for the annual Sydney Marathon.
  • N92 services departing Tallawong at 2am and 3am will operate via the Sydney Harbour Tunnel, ending trips at Town Hall, Park St, Stand K (2000252). Stops will be missed including Wynyard Station, York St, Stand K and Town Hall, Park St, Stand H. 
  • N92 services departing the city at 3.40am and 4.40am to Tallawong will also operate via the Sydney Harbour Tunnel starting trips from Town Hall, Park St, Stand K (2000252). Buses will not stop at Wynyard Clarence St, Stand R. 
  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.content:
Saturday 29 and Sunday 30 August
  • Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern.

  • Saturday from 5.30am to 9am, buses replace trains between Richmond and Blacktown.
  • From 9am to 11am, buses replace trains between Richmond and Schofields.
  • Trains run between Blacktown or Schofields and Liverpool.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
30T1  Richmond, all stations to Schofields and return
50T1  Richmond, all stations to Blacktown and return
57T1  Schofields, all stations to Blacktown and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

Fingal Head and Banora Point passengers can access Tweed City Shopping Centre from Minjungbal Drive. All other route 606 services will enter the Tweed City Shopping Centre carpark for the start and end of services.

See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, Route 396 buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the city, Darlinghurst Moore Park and Kingsford are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
 
Route 396 services will be affected in two stages throughout the day.  
  • From 4am to 2pm, buses will operate as a loop service between Maroubra Beach and Randwick Junction travelling via Anzac Pde, Avoca St, Alison Rd, Belmore Rd, Avoca St, Anzac Pde then as normal.
  • From 2pm to 4pm, services will resume running to and from Martin Place but continue to divert around Oxford St via Foveaux St, Albion St, Crown St and Cleveland St. 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD & North Sydney bus diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads including the Harbour Bridge are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  • From 2am to 12pm, route 290 buses will run to and from Crows Nest only. Buses will not run between Crows Nest, North Sydney and the city.  
  • Buses towards the city will end trips at Crows Nest Station, Pacific Hwy, Crows Nest (206515).

infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains from Gosford to Newcastle Interchange, in that direction only
infoLinks.content:
Friday 21 August
  • From 11.55pm, buses replace trains from Gosford to Newcastle Interchange, in that direction only.
  • Trains run from Central to Gosford, some to a changed timetable.
  • The 23:31 Newcastle Interchange to Gosford service runs to the normal timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
58CN  Gosford, all stations to Newcastle Interchange
67CN  Gosford, Tuggerah, Wyong, Morisset, Fassifern, Cardiff, Broadmeadow, Hamilton and Newcastle Interchange
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.content:

  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.

Changes to route S168:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • Minor change to Bilambil Public School afternoon pick up, from 3.10pm to 3.15pm.
  • No other changes and no transfers impacted.
See the news article for more information.

  • Most trips will terminate at Forest Rd in Lugarno, hourly weekday off peak services will continue to terminate at Boronia Pde in Lugarno.
  • Timetable changes may also impact your journey.
  • To find out more, visit Bus changes at Transport.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads including the Harbour Bridge are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  • From 3am to 5am, BN1 buses will start and end trips at QVB instead of Wynyard. Buses will not run to or from Wynyard due to road closures. Buses will use the Harbour Tunnel while the Harbour Bridge is closed.  
  • Buses to the city will end trips at QVB, York St, Stand D (200044). Buses towards Mona Vale will start trips from the same stop at QVB, York St, Stand D. Stops at Wynyard on Carrington St will be closed. 
  • Catch a train or walk to continue your trip between QVB and Wynyard. 
  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details. 
Missed stops: 
  • Wynyard Station, York St, Stand M (200035) 
  • Wynyard Station, Carrington St, Stand B, (200023) 
  • QVB, York St, Stand E (2000136)

infoLinks.urlText: Chatswood bus diversions for StreetFair
infoLinks.content:
On Saturday 5 September, route 267 services will be diverting around a section of Victoria Avenue and missing stops due to road closures for the Chatswood StreetFair. 
  • From midnight until 1pm and from 4pm until 9pm, buses in both directions will divert via Archer Street, Ashley Street and Anderson Street. Buses will start and end at Chatswood Interchange as normal. 
  • From 1pm until 4pm, buses will not run to or from Chatswood Interchange due to additional event road closures. Buses travelling towards Chatswood will end trips at Johnson St at Neridah St (206737). Buses leaving Chatswood will start trips at Archer St before Johnson St (206796). 
  • A free event shuttle bus will run in a loop along Penshurst Street, Victoria Avenue, Olga Street, Albert Avenue, Victor Street, Johnson Street, Fry Stret and Laurel Street between 5.15am and 10pm. 
  • Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations, allow extra travel time and plan ahead using the Trip Planner.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and South East diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, Route 370 buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the city, Darlinghurst Moore Park and Kingsford are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  • From 4am to 2pm, route 370 buses will be split into two routes – between Glebe and Kensington, and between Coogee and Randwick Junction. 
  • Glebe-Kensington: Buses leaving Glebe will end trips at Todman Ave at Balfour Rd, Kensington (203345). Buses towards Glebe will start trips from Todman Ave at Balfour Rd (203332). Catch L2 Randwick light rail services to the city for faster connections towards the Inner West. 
  • Coogee-Randwick: Buses from Coogee will end trips at Belmore Rd, Randwick Junction. Buses towards Coogee will leave from Belmore Rd at Avoca St Randwick (2031158). Catch L2 Randwick light rail services to the city for faster connections towards the Inner West. 
  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD & North Shore diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:

  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.content:

infoLinks.urlText: Opal can be used between Wollongong and Moss Vale, Exeter and Bundanoon stations.
infoLinks.content:
If travelling by Coach between Wollongong station and Moss Vale, Exeter or Bundanoon stations you can use your Opal card or contactless card or device to tap on or off at your origin/destination station provided the origin/destination is an Opal enabled station.

If travelling onto Goulburn, or other Opal enabled station along the Southern Highlands Line, you should not tap off when transferring from Coach to an Intercity train but instead tap off at your destination station.

Booking is not required for Opal customers on this route.

From 4am Monday, 4 April 2022
  • Parramatta Rd before Burwood Rd (213412) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 461X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd at Esher Lane (213431).
  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    The alternative stop for 415, 416X, 461N and 530 services will be Burwood Rd before Parramatta Rd (213462).

  • Parramatta Rd after Burwood Rd (213722) will be closed.
    Customers for the N70, N71, N80 and N81 towards City Town Hall should use the alternate stop on Parramatta Rd opp Neichs Pde (213721).

infoLinks.urlText: New school bus services for students from Calderwood and surrounds
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 April, three new school routes will be introduced to serve the Calderwood catchment and surrounds.

New routes:
  • S269 – Calderwood to St Josephs HS
  • S270 – Calderwood to Albion Park HS
  • S271 – Calderwood to Shellharbour Anglican College
These routes will be operated by Premier Illawarra and will service St Joseph’s Catholic High School, Albion Park High School and Shellharbour Anglican College.
 
Morning AM services
  • S269 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:38 and arrive at St
    Joseph’s at 07:48.
  • S270 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 07:58 and arrive
    at Albion Park HS at 08:09.
  • S271 – Bus will commence on Escarpment Drive at 08:20 and arrive at
    Shellharbour Anglican College at 08:50.
Afternoon PM services
  • S270 – Bus will depart Albion Park HS at 14:40 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 14:50.
  • S269 – Bus will depart St Joseph’s HS at 15:00 arriving at Escarpment
    Drive at 15:13.
  • S271 – Bus will depart Shellharbour Anglican College at 15:40 arriving at
    Escarpment Drive at 16:17.
Use the Trip Planner to plan your new trip.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus improvements in Kiama and Jamberoo from 20 July
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 July, we’re making changes to bus services in Kiama and Jamberoo to improve connectivity and travel times. 
 
The Route 125 service will see 10 additional weekly services added to the bus network between Jamberoo and Kiama on weekdays, including during school holidays. Additionally, students travelling to Jamberoo Public School from Curramore, Jamberoo and Kiama will benefit from a better-timed morning bus service.
 
Changes:
  • Changed timetable and route path for some trips.
  • The 7.35am from Kiama Station will no longer operate via Jamberoo Mountain Road.
Plan your trip and read the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 601:
  • New timetable and minor route path change.
  • 8 additional services per week, including additional weekday evening services to better suit shift times at Tweed Valley Hospital.
  • Extended from Tweed Valley Hospital to Kings Forest. 
  • Kings Forest residents have a new way to access TAFE NSW Kingscliff campus.
  • A change in Kingscliff town will see route 601 service Sutherland Street.
Every second route 601 service will terminate at Tweed City Shopping Centre. Passengers wanting to continue travel to Tweed Mall can take select route 601 services or change to other bus services at Tweed City Shopping Centre (routes 600, 603, 605, 606).  

See the news article for more information.

The new and improved bus timetable changes will increase travel options with more services across the week, especially weekday peaks, evenings and weekends.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 2 and Thursday 3 September
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Cronulla, Waterfall and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    - Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction.

  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport & South Line train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.

  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the city, Darlinghurst and Moore Park are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
 
From 4am to 4pm, route 333 services will operate between Bondi Beach and Kings Cross only. Buses will not continue to Circular Quay. 
 
Buses towards the city from Bondi will end trips at Bayswater Rd near Kellett St (201162). Buses towards Bondi will start trips from Kings Cross Station, Bayswater Rd, Stand D (201115).  
 
Change for trains at Kings Cross station to continue your trip towards Circular Quay or change at Bondi Junction station for trains towards Martin Place/Circular Quay instead. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads including the Harbour Bridge are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
 
From 3am to 11am, route 172X and 173X services will run between Warringah Mall and St Leonards via North Balgowlah/Balgowlah Shops only. Buses will not run to or from the city.  
 
Services to Warringah Mall will start trips from Crows Nest Station, Pacific Hwy (206515) also stopping at St Leonards Station, Pacific Hwy, Stand C (206521) and along Falcon St in North Sydney. Buses from Warringah Mall will end trips at St Leonards Station, Pacific Hwy. 
 
Catch a train or metro to continue your trip between St Leonards and the city. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details. 
 
Missed stops: 
  • Wynyard Station, York St (Stand M): 200035 
  • Wynyard Station, Carrington St (Stand A): 200021

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Waterfall, Cronulla and Hurstville. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Friday 4 September
  • From 10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport & South Line train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • From 11.55pm, buses replace trains between Waterfall, Cronulla and Hurstville.
  • Trains run between Mortdale or Hurstville and Bondi Junction, some to a changed timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
36T4  Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
41T4  Waterfall, all stations to Sutherland, express to Hurstville and return
42T4   Cronulla, all stations to Sutherland, express to Hurstville and return
43T4   Sutherland, all stations to Hurstville and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD bus diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the Sydney CBD are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  • From 3am to 3.30pm, route 461x will end trips at St James Station, Elizabeth St, Stand C (200057) instead of the Domain. Buses will start trips from Museum Station, Castlereagh St, Stand F (200058). Stops on Park St, Riley St and William St will be missed. 
  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

  • Hyde Park, Park St, Stand B (2000157)

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Waterfall and Hurstville. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Friday 4 September
  • From 10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Sydenham.
  • Buses run between Sydenham and Wolli Creek.
  • Change at Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • From 11.55pm, buses replace trains between Waterfall and Hurstville.
  • Trains run between South Coast Line stations and Waterfall, and between Hurstville and Bondi Junction, to a changed timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
36T4  Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
41T4  Waterfall, all stations to Sutherland, express to Hurstville and return
42T4  Cronulla, all stations to Sutherland, express to Hurstville and return
43T4  Sutherland, all stations to Hurstville and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

  • Buses run between Sydenham and Wolli Creek.
  • Change at Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • From 11.55pm, buses replace trains between Waterfall and Hurstville.
  • Trains run between South Coast Line stations and Waterfall, and between Hurstville and Bondi Junction, to a changed timetable.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
36T4  Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
41T4  Waterfall, all stations to Sutherland, express to Hurstville and return

43T4  Sutherland, all stations to Hurstville and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.content:

Buses will start trips from Harmony Park, Hunt St, Surry Hills (201026). Buses will not run to or from Circular Quay, stops on Elizabeth St, Phillip St and Alfred St will be missed.  
 
Change for trains at Museum to continue your trip. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus changes across Western Sydney from 5 July
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday 5 July, we’ll be making changes to some bus services across Western Sydney. 
  • Transport for NSW is introducing new bus services to connect Penrith, Oran Park, Campbelltown, Liverpool, Mount Druitt and Leppington with local centres, the new Western Sydney International Airport*, and in the future, to the emerging Bradfield City Centre.
  • New routes 772, 790, 825, 840, 845, 849 and 860 will deliver better connections 7 days a week for Western Sydney, linking communities to employment hubs, transport and essential services with frequent, reliable, and sustainable transport.
  • To find out more, read the news article and visit Bus changes at Transport or New Bus Services for Western Sydney.
*Passenger services will commence in October 2026.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 603:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • 8 additional services per week.
  • All services extended between Tweed City Shopping Centre and Tweed Mall.
  • A change in Kingscliff town will see the route 603 service Moss Street and Marine Parade.
  • Tweed City Shopping Centre will be serviced on Minjungbal Drive. 
See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, Route 311 buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the city, Darlinghurst and Moore Park are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
 
From 4am to 4pm, buses will operate in a loop between Crown St, Woolloomooloo and Bayswater Rd, Kings Cross only. Services towards Woolloomooloo will leave from Darlinghurst Rd near Bayswater Rd (201111).  
 
Buses will not make stops along Oxford St, at Central Station or in Millers Point. Catch trains or walk to continue your trip. 
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD & North Shore diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads including the Harbour Bridge are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon. 
  • From 3am to 11am, route 263 services will operate between Crows Nest Station and Milsons Point via Cremorne only. Buses will not run to or from the city. Services will start and end trips at Crows Nest Station, Pacific Hwy and Alfred St South in Milsons Point. Stops at Wynyard and North Sydney, and some stops in Crows Nest will be missed in both directions. Change for trains to continue your trip between Milsons Point and the city.  
  • From 11am to 3pm, route 263 buses will operate between Crows Nest and Wynyard Station via Cremorne only. Buses to the city will end trips at Wynyard Station, York St Stand P. Buses towards Crows Nest will start trips from Wynyard York St, Stand L. Stops on Bridge St will be missed. 
  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

  • High St after Clark Rd (206059)

infoLinks.urlText: T1 North Shore Line: Buses replace trains between Berowra and Gordon
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 22 and Sunday 23 August
  • Buses replace trains between Berowra and Gordon.
  • Trains run between Gordon and the City, some to a changed timetable.
  • Buses also replace T9 Northern and Central Coast & Newcastle Line trains.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
45T1  Berowra, all stations to Gordon and return
43T1  Berowra, all stations to Hornsby and return (early morning Saturday only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: L2, L3 partial line closures & extra L1, L2, L3 services for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
Due to major road closures in the city and South East on Sunday 30 August for the Sydney Marathon, L2 and L3 light rail services will be impacted throughout the day. 
  • Additional early morning services will run from 3.45am on L1, L2 and L3 lines. 
Services changes:
  • L2 Randwick Line:
    - From 3.45am to 11.40am, L2 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall. Services will run between Randwick and Town Hall only.
    - From 11.40am, full L2 services between Circular Quay and Randwick will resume as normal.

  • L3 Kingsford Line:
    - From 3.45am to 5.45am, L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall. Services will run between Juniors Kingsford and Town Hall only.
    - From 5.45am to 11.40am, L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall or between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford. L3 services will run between Moore Park and Town Hall only. Services.
    - From 11.40am to 2.30pm, L3 services will run between Moore Park and Circular Quay only. Services will not run between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford. 
    - From 2.30pm, services resume as normal operating between Circular Quay and Juniors Kingsford in both directions. 
Due to major event road closures in the Kensington and Kingsford areas, light rail replacement buses will not be operating. 
 
When L2 and L3 services are partially closed between Circular Quay and Town Hall, use alternative transport including trains or walking if able to. 
 
When L3 services are partially closed between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford, use alternative transport. L2 Randwick Line services continue to run to the city.  
 
Allow plenty of extra travel time as services will be busy. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport information.

Due to major road closures in the city and South East on Sunday 30 August for the Sydney Marathon, L2 and L3 light rail services will be impacted throughout the day. 
  • Additional early morning services will run from 3.45am on L1, L2 and L3 lines. 
Services changes:
  • L2 Randwick Line:
    - From 3.45am to 11.40am, L2 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall. Services will run between Randwick and Town Hall only.
    - From 11.40am, full L2 services between Circular Quay and Randwick will resume as normal.

  • L3 Kingsford Line:
    - From 3.45am to 5.45am, L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall. Services will run between Juniors Kingsford and Town Hall only.
    - From 5.45am to 11.40am, L3 services will not run between Circular Quay and Town Hall or between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford. L3 services will run between Moore Park and Town Hall only. Services.
    - From 11.40am to 2.30pm, L3 services will run between Moore Park and Circular Quay only. Services will not run between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford. 
    - From 2.30pm, services resume as normal operating between Circular Quay and Juniors Kingsford in both directions. 
Due to major event road closures in the Kensington and Kingsford areas, light rail replacement buses will not be operating. 
 
When L2 and L3 services are partially closed between Circular Quay and Town Hall, use alternative transport including trains or walking if able to. 
 
When L3 services are partially closed between Moore Park and Juniors Kingsford, use alternative transport. L2 Randwick Line services continue to run to the city.  
 
Allow plenty of extra travel time as services will be busy. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport information.
subtitle: L2, L3 partial line closures & extra L1, L2, L3 services for Sydney Marathon

infoLinks.urlText: Inner West trains will not run. T1 or T9 trains make extra stops. Buses replace some trains between Olympic Park and Ashfield or Central
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 29 and Sunday 30 August
  • Inner West trains do not run. T1 Western or T9 Northern Line trains make extra stops at some stations between Lidcombe and Central.
  • Trains run between Leppington and Lidcombe via Regents Park only. Change trains at Lidcombe to continue your journey.
  • You will need to change trains if travelling to Museum, St James or Circular Quay.

  • Saturday from 8pm to 2am, buses replace trains between Olympic Park and Ashfield or Central. Trackwork buses do not leave from Lidcombe. You may need to change services to continue your journey.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Ashfield and the City Circle.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
11T2  Olympic Park, all stations to Ashfield and return 
42T7  Olympic Park, Strathfield, Central and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD bus diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads including the Harbour Bridge are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  • From 3am to 11am, routes 288 and 292 buses will run to and from Crows Nest only. Buses will not run to and from the city.  
  • Buses towards the city will end trips at Crows Nest Station, Pacific Hwy, Crows Nest (206515).  Buses towards Macquarie Uni and Marsfield will start trips from Pacific Hwy opp Crows Nest Station, Crows Nest (206530).  
  • Stops on Sussex St, Clarence St and York St at will be missed.  
  • Change for metro services to continue your trip between Crows Nest and the city.  

  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Tweed bus changes from Monday 29 June
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 29 June, we'll be making some changes to bus services in the Tweed. 
  • These improvements will support better access to Tweed Valley Hospital, improve cross-border connectivity at Tweed Mall and provide bus services for new housing growth in Kings Forest.
  • Plan your trip for real time, up to date information.
Changes to route 605:
  • New timetable and route path change.
  • Doubling of service frequency from every 2 hours to every hour, and an additional 111 services per week.
  • 605 services will no longer travel via Keith Compton Drive and will instead stay on Wharf Street. Keith Compton Drive area will instead be serviced by route 606 services. Route 606 will service Florence Street, Powell Street, Solander Street, Banks Avenue, Keith Compton Drive and Brett Street. Alternatively passengers have the option to walk to Wharf Street to access more frequent bus services, including route 605. 
See the news article for more information.

infoLinks.urlText: Hunter bus changes from Sunday 28 June
infoLinks.content:

  • The improvements are part of the Bus Service Uplift program, with an additional 32 services per week on Route 164 Cessnock to Maitland via Kurri Kurri operated by Rover Motors.
  • The increase to the bus network will see more night-time and weekend services for the region with buses to run hourly, seven days a week, servicing the growing communities of Gillieston Heights, Cliftleigh and Heddon Greta. 
  • Use Trip Planner to plan your journey.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD and South East diversions for Sydney Marathon
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday 30 August, buses to and from the city will be diverting while major roads in the city, Darlinghurst Moore Park and Kingsford are closed for the annual Sydney Marathon.  
  • From 4am to 2pm, route 374 buses will start and end trips at Randwick, services will not continue to or from the city. Buses from Coogee will end trips at Darley Rd Opp Randwick TAFE (203144). Buses towards Coogee will leave from Alison Rd Opp Royal Randwick Racecourse (203111).  
  • Change at Randwick to connect with L2 Randwick Light rail services to the city. 
  • Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.

infoLinks.urlText: Bus changes across Greater Sydney from 21 June
infoLinks.content:
From Sunday 21 June,
  • Route M91 will be withdrawn and replaced by two new Routes to improve service reliability.
  • New Route 910 will replace Route M91 between Parramatta and Bankstown Station.
  • New Route 950 will replace Route M91 between Bankstown Central and Hurstville, operating directly along Forest Rd instead of George St and Cambridge St. New Route 952 will partially replace Route M91 on Cambridge St and George St.
  • Compared to Route M91, new Routes 910 and 950 will have longer operating hours throughout the week.
  • Timetable changes may also impact your journey.
  • To find out more, visit Bus changes at Transport.
